cases.name: document_password
cases.text: Reset a forgotten account password with a recovery link sent to the registered email address.

cases.name: document_two_factor
cases.text: If you lose an authenticator device, use a saved recovery code to regain access to your two-factor-protected account.

cases.name: document_billing_card
cases.text: Change the credit card used for future subscription payments in the billing settings.

cases.name: document_billing_refund
cases.text: Ask the billing team to review an accidental duplicate charge and issue a refund if appropriate.

cases.name: document_csv_export
cases.text: Export the current table as a CSV file with column headers for use in a spreadsheet.

cases.name: document_backup_restore
cases.text: Restore a database from a previously saved backup after checking the backup timestamp and destination.

cases.name: document_upload_limit
cases.text: An upload larger than the configured request body limit is rejected. Reduce the file size or raise the allowed upload size.

cases.name: document_gif
cases.text: An animated GIF submitted as an image is represented by its first rendered frame; the image embedder does not watch the full animation.

cases.name: document_video
cases.text: The video processor samples frames through time before encoding a video clip. A video is processed differently from a still image.

cases.name: document_api_key
cases.text: Revoke a compromised API key and generate a replacement. Update applications to use the new secret.

cases.name: document_delete_data
cases.text: Delete the requested customer records and verify that the deletion has reached every replica and backup retention policy.

cases.name: document_gpu_startup
cases.text: A model can take time to initialize its GPU runtime, upload weights, and prepare kernels before serving its first query.

cases.name: document_vector_dimensions
cases.text: An embedding is a vector of floating-point values. Documents and queries in the same vector index must use compatible models and dimensions.

cases.name: document_git_worktree
cases.text: Create an independent checkout with git worktree add so another branch can be edited without changing the current working directory.

cases.name: document_python_sort
cases.text: In Python, sorted(values, key=...) returns a new ordered list while list.sort changes the existing list in place.

cases.name: document_cache
cases.text: Cache repeated query results to avoid recomputing an expensive operation. Invalidate a cached value when its underlying data changes.

cases.name: document_audio
cases.text: Speech transcription turns recorded audio into written text. Embedding audio and transcribing it are separate tasks.

cases.name: document_earth
cases.text: Earth is the third planet from the Sun, with oceans, continents, a rotating surface, and a natural satellite called the Moon.

cases.name: document_mars
cases.text: Mars is a rocky planet with a red surface, thin atmosphere, polar ice caps, and the moons Phobos and Deimos.

cases.name: document_jupiter
cases.text: Jupiter is a gas giant with cloud bands and a long-lived storm called the Great Red Spot.
